recalls.summary: Braun Corporation (Braun) is recalling certain 2014-2019 Toyota Sienna mobility van conversions.  The brake lines may have incorrect tube nut fittings installed, which may cause a pressure drop within the braking system.

recalls.summary: Vantage Mobility International, LLC (Vantage) is recalling certain 2012-2018 AMS Genesis wheelchair vans, built on a Toyota Sienna vehicles.  The rubber brake hoses that attach to the rear wheel assembly may be too short, causing them to rub against the rear axle trailing arm.
